overview.description: The Calamos S&P 500 Structured Alt Protection Etf June (CPSU) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund seeks to track the return of the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY), to a cap, with 100% downside hedge over a one-year outcome period. The actively managed fund holds FLEX options to obtain exposure CPSU was launched on Jun 2, 2025 and is issued by Calamos.
